The incident highlighted existing management issues at the Doma village ashram school. Overcrowding and poor sanitation contributed to the students' anxiety and fear. Authorities plan awareness drives to combat superstition in the region.
title: 'Girls laugh, cry, then go numb': 608 flee Maha school amid 'mass hysteria'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Twelve people died and ten were seriously injured after a Polish bus overturned early Sunday. The bus ran off the M3 motorway and tipped into a ditch near Mezokeresztes. Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar announced the tragic casualties on Facebook. He also expressed his sincere condolences to the families of the victims. The exact cause of the accident remains unknown at this time.
title: Hungary bus crash: 12 killed, 10 injured after Polish bus overturns on M3 motorway

author: CHETHAN KUMAR
description: Modern technology works so well it becomes invisible to users.  This invisibility makes critical thinking about scientific claims essential today.  We must ask how we know things and what evidence supports them.  Developing disciplined curiosity is a necessary defense against misinformation.  Looking at familiar things from new angles offers valuable perspective.
title: The trouble with getting used to miracles

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Kerala's Cabinet has officially greenlit the second phase of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban 2.0, paving the way for around 30,000 eligible beneficiaries to gain significant housing aid. The state plans to ink a Memorandum of Understanding with the Central government, which will unlock Rs 450 crore in financial support for this housing initiative. The completion of phase one is projected for September 2026.
title: PMAY-U 2.0: Kerala's 30,000 beneficiaries may get Rs 4 lakh housing assistance

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A 14th-century skeleton found beneath Scotland’s Stirling Castle may be the first confirmed archaeological evidence of a person killed by a trebuchet. Researchers found more than 160 fractures, including 61 breaks in the skull and nearly 60 in the ribs. The injuries suggest the man was struck from behind by a high-speed boulder during the 1304 siege of the castle.
title: Skeleton under Stirling Castle reveals first confirmed trebuchet death

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Virgil Earp, known for surviving the infamous O.K. Corral gunfight, embraced a new beginning as a homesteader in Arizona. Claiming 160 acres near Prescott through the federal homesteading process, his prior service in the Civil War lessened his residency obligation to just two years. By 1900, he secured his property title, stepping into a life that diverged significantly from his days as a frontier lawman.
title: In 1898, Virgil Earp claimed 160 acres in Arizona after surviving O.K. Corral

description: A sailor and his two young children were discovered deceased at their Mumbai residence. Preliminary findings suggest the sailor died by suicide, while the children may have been poisoned. Police have initiated a thorough investigation into the tragic incident. Post-mortem and forensic reports are awaited for confirmation of causes. Investigators are gathering statements from witnesses to establish the sequence of events.
title: Navy sailor, wife and 2 children found dead at Mumbai home

Nato officials have warned about dangerous and unacceptable airspace violations.

description: Dak Prescott’s journey into fatherhood has transformed how he views life, time and legacy. The Dallas Cowboys quarterback now looks beyond football and wants to experience every stage of his children’s lives, including seeing the families they may build someday. author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Amateur astronomer Joël Lapointe has unveiled a massive impact crater in Quebec known as the Uhackatik structure, formed by a meteorite 390 million years ago. Geologists have validated this discovery through the identification of shatter cones and melted rock, ensuring the event's authenticity. This find stands as one of the most significant meteorite craters discovered in recent history, with satellite imagery playing a key role in identifying such geological phenomena.
title: In 2024, a Google Maps user found a giant meteorite crater scientists had missed

description: The Farallon Islands are grappling with an overwhelming invasion of house mice, significantly disturbing the delicate ecological system. author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In 1987, British naturalist Ian Bullock established Aride Island as a key conservation hub. His initiative led to the successful relocation of endangered Seychelles warblers the following year, significantly bolstering the species' numbers and preventing potential extinction. Today, their population thrives, and Bullock's innovative conservation methods are now standard practices in island ecosystem management.
